evidence.nota: No owner bundle for this candidate. Synthetic validator tests are not joint qualification evidence.

pass_conditions: The adopted normative contract takes precedence: lawful declarations and non-prohibited discrepancies are tested separately from prohibited CRS conflicts.

Lawful inputs: identity preserves every property byte-for-byte; derived fields are reconstructed from the actual result; explicit lawful plans and unavoidable transformations have localized reports and independently verified expected output.

GEO-005/REJ-001 prohibited conflicts: each component rejects at its first public validating boundary with category crs, four error axes, remote_effect none and matching before/after destination snapshots, on every surface.
Preservation and propagation after a prohibited rejection are skipped with reason, never counted as passed.
All three components, ICD and executed harness have immutable revisions backed by Git commit objects; executed artifacts are hashed and bound to platform, surface, command and run.
All required fixtures, variants, directions, native platforms, surfaces and properties have complete evidence; not_run, partial, failed and unrelated artifacts cannot satisfy the gate.
The owner bundle binds manifest, lock, actual Arrow input/output/expected observations, loss reports, commands, environment, logs and absence-of-effect evidence by SHA-256.
open_blockers: No complete owner bundle for the current three-component candidates and adopted ICD has been delivered.
Native Windows execution of the complete matrix is not qualified.
The full property matrix, derived operations, lawful explicit plans and prohibited CRS rejection probes remain to be qualified in both directions on all surfaces.
open_blockers_nota: Historical Linux evidence from 13 November 2026 is partial and does not satisfy this gate; the inverse direction is no longer described as never executed. No historical result is promoted.
components_nota: le revisioni sono `null` perche' la qualifica non e' stata eseguita: le fissa l'owner esterno al momento della corsa, e una revisione vecchia qui descriverebbe una campagna che non e' quella corrente

input_rules.prohibited_crs: GEO-005/REJ-001: reject crs at the first validating boundary; all surfaces, four axes, no effect; preservation skipped with reason.
input_rules.lawful_discrepancy: Only discrepancies not forbidden by the adopted contract: preserve and propagate unless an explicit lawful plan changes them.
input_rules.lawful: Identity preserves properties byte-for-byte; derived and declared transformations require an independent expected result and localized reports.

bundle_contract.integrity: SHA-256 of every referenced artifact; Git commit object identities; complete per-cell execution and property comparisons.
bundle_contract.trust_boundary: Offline consistency and byte comparisons do not authenticate the owner, prove execution, or establish membership of a Git object in a remote repository.
